{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin Relief Fund''' was a legitimate charity that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It provided [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], and shelter to refugees and indigenous populations throughout the system.
